Old Dragon

Overview

Old Dragon inhabits the mountain lair where Zak expects to find a magician. Amused by the visitor, he invokes old traditions and offers answers in return for a task: poison the underground spring used by the noisy armadillos beneath his home. The meeting turns a mistaken destination into another lead in Zak’s search. [1, 2]

The Old Dragon on Lone Mountain

The observatory’s password takes Zak into the Dead City and up Lone Mountain. He expects the magician from the Orb but finds Old Dragon. The dragon insists on an old bargain: a visitor must perform a task before receiving an answer. Zak deals with the armadillos beneath the lair, using the poison the dragon supplies. The dragon then admits that he cannot identify Zak or locate Gipath’s elusive Great Magician. He suggests the ancient lizards might know more and points instead to an expedition of armoured outsiders. He withdraws the skeletons he had used against their camp. In a further conversation, he gives Zak an old sword because he enjoys his company and would rather not see him become another speechless skeleton. [3, 1, 4, 2, 5]
